proposals: OWNER DECISION, then primary loop - evidence/facts/extract.py _source_build_fact with core/ecosystems.py and validation/registry.py _check_install: a registry-less ecosystem is structurally excluded from BC-02. The polarity gate admits only CONTRADICTED while C++ is UNRESOLVED (no registry to contradict it), and CPP.source_install is empty by documented intent. Together, no C++ repository can ever pass BC-02 - while its install command is the most verified of any ecosystem's, since cpp_examples itself drives `cmake -S . -B build` / `cmake --build build` to build each library before compiling its examples, and it succeeded for all four. Smallest fix: polarity gate to {CONTRADICTED, UNRESOLVED} plus a C++ source_install. Blocks all four.

primary loop, composition/planning.py plan_checks: 7ea433e deferred the impossible placement at S4 and left the identical failure at S5, for additional_examples - the one condition planning recomputes after the quick starts consume examples. On placement.outcome == 'excluded', defer the unit as dispositions.normalize already does, rather than appending an error no re-ask can answer. Blocks Email.

primary loop, validation/registry.py _COMMAND and _PLACING: `python-pptx` in prose is read as a command (the python3? alternative followed by \b matches the hyphen boundary; python-docx, go-*, git-*, make-*, cargo-* are the same class), and _PLACING then requires VERIFIED_REWRITE - the disposition that re-authors by definition - to preserve it verbatim. Either fix alone clears it; both are worth landing. Blocks Slides on BC-08.
